source: Each state's page on the IRS list of state government websites (https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/state-government-websites), read 2026-10-31. Each link was opened then: "opened" means it answered; "blocks automated reading" means the site exists but refused this client (403, timeout or certificate chain); "robots.txt disallows automated reading" means its robots file asks crawlers to stay out, which HAYAT respects when fetching. Links that were gone (404, no DNS) were dropped. statutes.laws.com (an unofficial publisher) was removed; a bot-check redirect was replaced by the state link it guarded.
